  <section class="ah-section ah-research" id="research" aria-labelledby="ah-research-title">
    <div class="ah-section-top"><h2 id="ah-research-title">Research focus</h2><a href="/year-archive/">Read my writing <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div>
    <p class="ah-research-lead">I study <strong>Generative Models (Diffusion/Flow-Matching)</strong> and <strong>VLM Foundation Models</strong>, for which you can find more in my <a href="/year-archive/">blog post</a>.</p>
    <div class="ah-research-grid">
      <article class="ah-research-item">
        <p class="ah-kicker">01 / The generative side</p>
        <h3>Fidelity. Speed. Control.</h3>
        <p>I study the “impossible triangle” of high fidelity, fast sampling, and strong controllability—designing training and inference methods (distillation, guidance, solver-aware sampling) that expand the Pareto frontier.</p>
      </article>
      <article class="ah-research-item">
        <p class="ah-kicker">02 / The understanding side</p>
        <h3>Understanding and creation, together.</h3>
        <p>I study to build native VLM architectures that achieve a true unification of understanding and generation, enabling AI to perceive, reason, and create within a single, cohesive framework.</p>
      </article>
    </div>
    <p class="ah-previous"><strong>Previously:</strong> I have also worked on areas including recommender systems, federated learning and AI safety. I have published multiple research papers at AI conferences such as ICLR and AAAI (<a href="/publications/">Publication</a>).</p>
  </section>

    <details class="gx-details" id="gx-process">
<summary>Inside the pipeline — from intent to a finished video</summary>
<div class="gx-detail-grid">
<div>
<h4>01 / Code-driven animation</h4>
<ol><li><strong>Plan the explanation</strong>Build an outline and storyboard from the topic, duration and visual style.</li><li><strong>Write, voice and render</strong>Generate shot-level narration, synthesize speech, write Manim code and repair rendering errors.</li><li><strong>Align and export</strong>Match animation to narration and subtitles. Export MP4, WAV, SRT / VTT, source code and the timeline.</li></ol>
</div>
<div>
<h4>02 / Model-generated stories</h4>
<ol><li><strong>Define the story world</strong>Plan 2–8 shots from a brief. Attach reference images to specific characters, scenes or the overall style.</li><li><strong>Generate and review shots</strong>Optionally inspect sampled frames, revise prompts and select candidates. Continuity guidance tracks visual references and scene state.</li><li><strong>Assemble the story</strong>Normalize the selected clips and join them on a shared timeline, with storyboard and production records available for inspection.</li></ol>
</div>
</div>
<p class="gx-detail-note">Shot refinement and continuity guidance are independent options. Visual review uses sampled frames; consistency depends on the selected model and references.</p>
</details>

Genesis is the studio interface of my Code2X project.</p><a href="https://github.com/innovation-cat/FormaWeave" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Web project on GitHub <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  var root = document.getElementById('genesis-project');
  if (!root) return;
  var tabs = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]'));
  var panels = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]'));
  function selectMode(mode, moveFocus) {
    root.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(function (video) { video.pause(); });
    tabs.forEach(function (tab) {
      var active = tab.dataset.mode === mode;
      tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
      tab.tabIndex = active ? 0 : -1;
      if (active && moveFocus) tab.focus();
    });
    panels.forEach(function (panel) { panel.hidden = panel.dataset.panel !== mode; });
  }
  tabs.forEach(function (tab, index) {
    tab.addEventListener('click', function () { selectMode(tab.dataset.mode, false); });
    tab.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
      var next;
      if (event.key === 'ArrowRight') next = (index + 1) % tabs.length;
      else if (event.key === 'ArrowLeft') next = (index + tabs.length - 1) % tabs.length;
      else if (event.key === 'Home') next = 0;
      else if (event.key === 'End') next = tabs.length - 1;
      else return;
      event.preventDefault();
      selectMode(tabs[next].dataset.mode, true);
    });
  });
  selectMode('model', false);
  root.querySelector('.gx-tabs').hidden = false;
  root.querySelectorAll('.gx-screen video').forEach(function (video) {
    var playButton = video.parentElement.querySelector('.gx-play');
    video.controls = false;
    playButton.hidden = false;
    playButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
      video.controls = true;
      playButton.hidden = true;
      var attempt = video.play();
      if (attempt && typeof attempt.catch === 'function') {
        attempt.catch(function () { playButton.hidden = false; });
      }
    });
    video.addEventListener('play', function () { playButton.hidden = true; });
    video.addEventListener('ended', function () { video.controls = false; playButton.hidden = false; });
  });
  var slider = root.querySelector('#gx-structure');
  var canvas = root.querySelector('.gx-hybrid-canvas');
  root.querySelector('.gx-range').hidden = false;
  slider.addEventListener('input', function () {
    canvas.style.setProperty('--gx-split', slider.value + '%');
  });
  canvas.dataset.interactive = 'true';
  function revealAt(event) {
    var bounds = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    var value = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width * 100)));
    slider.value = String(value);
    canvas.style.setProperty('--gx-split', value + '%');
  }
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (event) {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    canvas.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    revealAt(event);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
    if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) revealAt(event);
  });
  canvas.addEventListener('pointerup', function (event) {
    if (canvas.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) canvas.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
  });
  var process = root.querySelector('#gx-process');
  root.querySelector('a[href="#gx-process"]').addEventListener('click', function () { process.open = true; });
  if (window.location.hash === '#gx-process') process.open = true;
}());
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  /* The retained theme restores only one navigation item per resize.
     Finish its layout routine on this page after the width settles. */
  function fitAboutNavigation() {
    var nav = document.getElementById('site-nav');
    var hiddenLinks = nav && nav.querySelector('.hidden-links');
    if (!hiddenLinks || typeof window.updateNav !== 'function') return;
    for (var attempt = 0; attempt < 6; attempt += 1) {
      var before = hiddenLinks.children.length;
      window.updateNav();
      if (hiddenLinks.children.length === before) break;
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', fitAboutNavigation);
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () { window.requestAnimationFrame(fitAboutNavigation); });
}());
</script>
